2609.39723.title: Let the Carrier Carry the Attack: Preserving the Subject in Adversarial Image Generation
2609.39723.paper_summary: Strong unrestricted adversarial attacks can distort the primary object of an image, hereafter referred to as the subject. To preserve subject integrity without compromising attack magnitude, we introduce the carrier: a secondary visual element that provides an auxiliary region to facilitate the attack under global classifier guidance. We demonstrate three key findings: 1. A carrier mitigates subject distortion by absorbing a larger share of globally normalized attack updates. 2. A carrier improves cross-model transferability, governed by the strength of target-related features that balance semantic separation and transfer performance. 3. Successful targeted attacks retain the personalized subject as the primary content perceived by humans while successfully misleading the classifier. Our results demonstrate that a visually secondary carrier offers an auxiliary spatial pathway for adversarial changes, enabling strong and transferable attacks while improving subject preservation.
2609.39723.paper_summary_zh: 強大的無限制對抗攻擊可以扭曲圖像的主要物體，以下稱為主題。為了在不妥協攻擊強度的情況下保護主題的完整性，我們引入了載體：一種次要的視覺元素，提供輔助區域以在全局分類器的指導下促進攻擊。我們展示了三個關鍵發現：1. 載體通過吸收更大比例的全局標準化攻擊更新來減輕主題扭曲。2. 載體改善了跨模型的可轉移性，這受到目標相關特徵強度的支配，平衡語義分離和轉移性能。3. 成功的針對性攻擊保持個性化的主題作為人類感知的主要內容，同時成功誤導分類器。我們的結果表明，視覺上的次要載體提供了一條輔助的空間通道來進行對抗性變化，使得強大且可轉移的攻擊成為可能，同時改善了主題的保護。
